data.notes: Demo note: keep the clearer hierarchy; review the primary action placement.

pins.text: Demo flag: place the check-in action beside its session context. This request is not applied to r3.

details.summary: Fictional dashboard review: compare the baseline and three preserved design iterations. The sample flag asks for a further action-placement change; it is pending, not already applied.

elements.name: Next-session hierarchy
elements.current: Session information competes with summary metrics.
elements.proposed: The next session becomes the first meaningful task on the page.
elements.reason: Providers can identify what they need to do next before reading secondary information.
elements.keep: Session time, participant and service context.
elements.accessibility: Use a clear heading and a descriptive primary action. Verify reading order and focus in the actual app.
elements.platform: Preserve the task and information across Android, iOS and PWA; adapt safe areas and navigation.
elements.status: Shown in the fictional r3 capture; no shipping app was changed.

elements.name: Check-in action · saved flag 1
elements.current: The existing action is separated from the session information.
elements.proposed: The saved request moves the check-in action into the next-session card.
elements.reason: Placing the action beside its context reduces searching and makes the intended task explicit.
elements.keep: All existing session details and eligibility rules.
elements.accessibility: Use a named button, adequate contrast and a touch target suited to the platform.
elements.platform: Review the same action, state and fixture data on each supported platform.
elements.status: Changes requested. This placement is not yet applied to r3.

elements.name: Secondary metrics
elements.current: Several metrics attract equal visual attention.
elements.proposed: Supporting metrics sit below the main task with a quieter visual treatment.
elements.reason: The dashboard should prioritize an actionable session over informational totals.
elements.keep: Access to useful performance and schedule information.

elements.name: Navigation and responsive layout
elements.current: The baseline distributes attention across navigation and cards.
elements.proposed: The proposal gives the task area more space while retaining familiar destinations.
elements.reason: Keep navigation predictable while the content hierarchy improves.
elements.platform: Mobile and desktop captures use comparable fictional data. Mobile platform variants here are simulations, not native-device proof.

items.title: Apply only the authorized next-session change
items.detail: If the request is picked up by a connected worker, preserve r3 and publish a new immutable revision with its own captures and review decision.

details.scope: Fictional visual review. No product implementation, physical-device validation or deployment has occurred. A connected agent is required to process queued work.
